se_tip.alert.lead: What shows up in the stream when a donation arrives.
se_tip.alert.test_failed: Nothing sent. Text and video are both empty, or no overlay is listening.
se_tip.alert.test_hint: These values are for the test only and are not saved.
se_tip.alert.test_sent: Test sent – have a look at the overlay.
se_tip.alert.test_while_all_off: Alerts are switched off entirely – this test would not arrive.
se_tip.alert.title: Alert on a donation
se_tip.appearance_lead: Markup and stylesheet of the donation bar in the overlay.
se_tip.bind.fill: The progress bar – its width comes from both amounts.
se_tip.bind.title: The name of the running goal.
se_tip.confirm_delete: Really delete the goal “%{name}”? The amount collected so far goes with it.
se_tip.empty: No donation goal yet. Create one – donations always go to the topmost.
se_tip.error.rate_limit: Too many requests to StreamElements. Please wait a moment.
se_tip.error.unauthorized: StreamElements rejects the access. The token is probably no longer valid.
se_tip.error.unknown_channel: StreamElements does not know this channel ID.
se_tip.format_hint: data-format="euro" shows amounts with two decimals and a currency sign, data-format="int" as a whole number.
se_tip.how_first: On the first run nothing is added retroactively – only donations from now on count. Otherwise a whole year of history would land on the first goal.
se_tip.how_poll: Polled every %{seconds} seconds – as long as the background process ticks that often. By default that is 15 seconds; to really get the shorter interval, set WORKER_INTERVAL=5 in the .env.
se_tip.how_target: Every donation goes to the topmost goal in the list. Once it is full, move it down or delete it.
se_tip.is_default: The shipped appearance is in use. As soon as you save something, your version applies – and fixes to the default will no longer reach you.
se_tip.missing_hint: Required elements are missing from the markup – it was saved anyway:
se_tip.name: Tip-Goals – StreamElements
se_tip.no_credentials: No StreamElements access is stored yet – that is why the goals do not grow on their own.
se_tip.no_script_hint: script, iframe, object, embed, style and attributes like onclick are stripped from the markup – this is about appearance.
se_tip.perm.edit: may create, change, move and delete donation goals and store the access data.
se_tip.required_hint: Without these elements the bar shows nothing in the overlay – and that only becomes apparent mid-stream.
se_tip.reset_question: Discard your own markup and stylesheet and use the shipped one again?
se_tip.scope_hint: Keep your rules inside .goal-tip. An unscoped rule describes the same classes as the Twitch goals – then their bars look different depending on load order.
se_tip.settings_lead: Token and channel ID used to fetch the donations.
se_tip.title: Name
se_tip.token_set: stored – leave empty to keep it
se_tip.token_where: The token is in StreamElements under “Account → Show secrets” as the JWT token, the channel ID next to it.
se_tip.too_many: More than %{max} goals is no longer a list.
